tests.name: Open passage: concrete route is collision-free and stays in known cells
A wall changes reachability and separates free-space components
Unknown is blocked by default and provisional traversal is explicit
Larger footprint never opens cells blocked for the smaller footprint
Backward replay restores unknown rather than retaining future observations
Path endpoints and invalid coordinates are handled deterministically
Synthetic geometry is deterministic, finite and independent of video
Initial interface has computed map and explicit synthetic metadata
Scenario selection updates map, components and failure reason
Playback, seeking and layers invoke state transitions
Footprint and height controls update state and labels
Start/goal mode, swap and object filter are wired
Help and export dialogs open with truthful provenance
Local video remains explicitly disconnected from synthetic reconstruction
